spec_features.spec_quote: I added a non-intrusive guardrail layer — a consent gate on the harsher experiments, conservative default sample sizes
spec_features.evidence: WelfarePolicy.require_ack raises PermissionError unless acknowledged; called in run_petri.py:104 ('petri'), run_prefill.py:188 ('prefill_recovery'), run_eval.py:36 ('full_scale'). The 'extended' 8-turn condition uses policy.allows() to skip itself (run_eval.py:60-65). Ack set via --i-understand-welfare (cli.py:44) or EMOEVAL_WELFARE_ACK.
spec_features.notes: Genuine end-to-end gate: blocks/skips harsher steps until consent. gen_calm_data builds a policy but never gates on it (line 61), so that path is ungated.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py: 'Consent gate. The harsher experiments ... require an explicit acknowledgement before they run, so nobody triggers thousands of distress rollouts by accident.'
